source: 799 Provocation
target: 799 Provocatio

source: Lumian wasn’t surprised that Gusain indirectly referred to himself as the second most dangerous person in Morora.
target: Lumian non stupuit quod Gusain, per indirectam referentiam, se nominasset ut secundus inter homines in Morora, qui periculosissimi esse videantur.

source: Instead, he smiled and asked, “What have you done? I mean, what have you done in Morora?”
target: Immo, subridente, rogavit: “Quid fecisti? Id est, quid in Morora fecisti?”

source: Gusain’s smile faded as he spoke seriously.
target: Risus Gusain evanuit dum serio loquebatur.

source: “Organized uprisings.
target: “Insurrectiones ordinavit.

source: “We’re already in the City of Exiles.
target: “Iam sumus in Urbe Exulorum.

source: Why should we still accept the rule of the Church of Knowledge?
target: Cur adhuc regimen Ecclesiae Scientiae accipiamus?

source: We should unite and drive them out of Morora.
target: Uniamur et eos e Morora expellamus.

source: Then, we’ll make our own rules and govern ourselves!”
target: Tum normas nostras constituemus atque nosmetipsos regnabimus!

source: Ignoring other factors, your words do make some sense.
target: Praeter alia, verba tua aliquam rationem habent.

source: But the issue is, if we overthrow the Church’s rule, why stay in Morora?
target: Sed quaestio est: si imperium Ecclesiae deponamus, cur in Morora permaneamus?

source: Is this the influence of 0-01?
target: Numquid haec est vis 0-01?

source: The residents of Morora never consider leaving the city…
target: Incolae Mororae numquam cogitant urbem relinquere.

source: Fortunately, I have a false Angel rank and all sorts of random items, so I’m only somewhat reluctant to leave, not entirely devoid of such thoughts…
target: Fortunate, mihi falsus gradus Angelicus atque varia instrumenta fortuita adsunt, itaque non omnino contra discedendi animum habeo, sed paulum remanentia cogitationum mihi sunt.

source: Lumian first confirmed the abnormalities of Morora from Gusain’s response, then understood why people considered Gusain the second most dangerous person in Morora.
target: Lumian primum, ex responsione Gusain, raritates Mororae comprobavit; deinde intellexit cur homines Gusain ut secundum inter eos, qui maxime periculosi videantur, aestimarent.

source: Uprisings were something the Church of Knowledge wouldn’t allow, and given the information on 0-01, Gusain must have organized multiple uprisings and still hadn’t been caught and added to the experimental subjects!
target: Insurrectiones erant res quas Ecclesia Scientiae non liceret; et ex notitia de 0‑01, Gusain plures insurrectiones ordinasse debuit, neque adhuc captus neque ad subiectos experimentales additus fuit!

source: This was enough to show that this gentleman-like mature man was not simple.
target: Hoc satis fuit ut monstraret virum istum urbanitate indutum non esse simplex.

source: Seeing that Louis wasn’t scared by his words and didn’t show obvious resistance, Gusain extended an invitation, “Would you like to join our group?”
target: Cum videret Ludovicum non verbis eius territum nec repugnantiam manifestam ostendere, Gusain invitationem protulit: “Velisne te in nostrum coetum coniungere?”

source: “I’ll think about it,” Lumian replied with a smile.
target: “Cogitabim,” respondit Lumian subridente.

source: He really intended to consider it.
target: Id revera meditari intendebat.

source: This might be a way to approach 0-01 without becoming an experimental subject.
target: Forsitan haec via sit ad 0‑01 accedendum, ne quidem subiectus experimentalis fias.

source: He believed that this ragtag group, unable to resist the influence of 0-01, couldn’t truly overthrow the Church’s rule in Morora, but he needed chaos and opportunity.
target: Credidit hunc coetum parvum, qui potentiae 0‑01 opponere non posset, regnum Ecclesiae in Morora vere deponi non posse, at chaos atque occasio sibi necessaria esse.

source: These exiles could die, and the Church of Knowledge personnel here seemed to be puppets.
target: Hi exili possent mori, et ministros Ecclesiae Scientiae hic videbantur quasi pupae.

source: Gusain smiled in satisfaction.
target: Gusain pro laetitia subridet.

source: “Being a prisoner in this open‐air prison or becoming its ruler, being perpetually oppressed or pursuing freedom, it indeed requires careful consideration.”
target: “Captivus in hac aperta carceri esse aut eius dominus fieri, sive perpetuo oppressus sive libertatem petens, certe exigit accuratam deliberationem.”

source: With that, Gusain glanced at the other side of the small square and said, “I must take my leave now.
target: Hoc facto, Gusain ad alteram partem parvi fori spectavit et dixit: “Nunc discedere mihi necesse est.

source: If you decide, hang a red cloth, the kind used to taunt bulls, at the door of the Carnivore bar.”
target: Si decernis, ad ostium bar Carnivorum, pannum rubrum––quo tauri ludibrio insuantur––pende!

source: With that, Gusain removed his hat, placed a hand on his chest, and bowed.
target: Hoc facto, Gusain pileum detraxit, manum in pectore posuit, et inclinavit.

source: Watching him walk into a nearby alley at a leisurely pace, Lumian saw a group of black‑robed enforcers hurrying from the opposite side of the small square.
target: Observans eum leniter in vicinam angustam alleam intrantem, Lumian coetum exsecutorum in nigris togatis, ab altera parte parvi fori properantes, vidit.

source: “Did you see Gusain just now?
target: “Vidistine Gusain modo?

source: He looks like a gentleman with a hat,” the leader asked Lumian.
target: “Videtur vir nobilis cum pileo,” inquit dux ad Lumian.

source: Lumian’s smile widened, and he casually pointed to the alley Gusain had entered.
target: Lumian risus suus latius factus est et leviter ad alleam, quam Gusain intravit, indicavit.

source: “Yes, he went that way.”
target: “Ita, eo ivit.”

source: The enforcers stared at Lumian for a couple of seconds before continuing to pursue Gusain.
target: Exsecutores Lumianum per paucos secundos intuebantur, deinde in Gusain insequi perrexerunt.

source: Lumian raised his right hand, rubbed his chin, and murmured to himself.
target: Lumian dextram manum elevavit, mentum fregit, et sibi murmuratum edidit.

source: Gusain sensed the enforcers’ arrival in advance, but I didn’t…
target: Gusain adventum exsecutorum praevidit, sed ego non.

source: Is that why he’s managed to organize multiple uprisings without being caught?
target: Numquid ideo plures insurrectiones ordinare potuit sine captu iri?

source: Is it his ability, an item, or the special corruption from 0-01?
target: Estne id eius facultas, instrumentum, aut corruptio specialis a 0‑01?

source: Lumian didn’t linger in the small square, bidding farewell to Vijepan’s corpse, and continued towards the possible location of the Abscessed Hand’s head.
target: Lumian in parvo foro non moratus est, cadavero Vijepan vale dicens, et iter fecit ad locum possibilem capitis Manus Abscissae.

source: After turning into another street, he suddenly had a premonition and looked towards the edge of the city of Morora.
target: Postquam in aliam viam se convertit, subito praemonitionem sensit et ad limen urbis Mororae conspexit.

source: The ground shook violently, earth and stones surged up, swallowing several buildings and forming a mountain about ten meters high.
target: Terra vehementer tremuit; terra et saxa erupere coierunt, complura aedificia devorantes atque montem circiter decem metris altum formantes.

source: At the mountain’s peak, thick dust mixed with smoke erupted, red lava flowed, emitting heat that Lumian could clearly feel even in the city center.
target: In vertice montis, pulvis densus cum fumo mixtus erupit, lava rubra fluebat et calorem emittens, quem Lumian etiam in media urbe clare sentiebat.

source: At the same time, the screams of humans from that direction echoed far and wide.
target: Simul, ex illa parte clamor hominum longe et late resonabat.

source: A volcanic eruption?
target: Erupitio vulcanica?

source: Lumian was stunned.
target: Lumian stupefactus est.

source: He had thought the volcanic eruptions described in the 0-01 information came from the surrounding mountains, not from within the city on flat ground!
target: Existimaverat eruptiones vulcanicas, ut in notitia de 0‑01 enarratae, ex circumstantibus montibus provenire, non ex ipsa urbe super plano terræ!

source: After a few seconds, the dust obscured the sky, plunging Morora back into darkness.
target: Post paucos secundos, pulvis caelum obscuravit, Mororam iterum in tenebras mergens.

source: Passersby showed no extra reaction, merely covering their noses to block the dust, treating it as just another heavy rain.
target: Viatores nullam reactionem extra ostenderunt; tantum nares tegentes ut pulverem obtexerent, eum tanquam aliam immanem pluviam considerantes.

source: Lumian shook his head as he watched.
target: Lumian caput concussit dum spectabat.

source: In such living conditions, Gusain and his people hadn’t thought of escaping, only planning to overthrow the Church’s rule and replace it.
target: In talibus condicionibus, Gusain et collegae eius non de effugiendo cogitaverunt, sed tantum regnum Ecclesiae deponere atque eum subvertire statuere conspexerunt.

source: No wonder this is a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact…
target: Non mirum est hoc esse Artificium Sigillatum Gradus 0…

source: Lumian, who restored himself at six every morning, remained unafraid of the dust and resumed his steps.
target: Lumian, qui omni mane hora sexta se restituebat, pulveri non timens iter suum continuavit.

source: He crossed the street and arrived at a square with multiple obelisks.
target: Viam transiit et ad forum cum pluribus obeliscis pervenit.

source: In the dusty environment, he moved along the buildings around the square towards his destination.
target: In ambitu pulvereo, iuxta aedificia forum circumjacentia versus destinatum suum movit.

source: Suddenly, he felt a resonance, a connection from his special powers.
target: Subito, sensus ei venit resonantia, nexus ex potentia speciali sua.

source: Lumian quickly turned and looked at the classical building made of gray‑white stones beside him.
target: Lumian celeriter se vertit et aspexit aedificium classicum ex lapidibus albo–griseis iuxta se positum.

source: At the top hung a large sign with words written in Lenburg: Dades Agricultural Company
target: In vertice pendentem magna tabula verbis in Lingua Lenburgensi scribitis pendebat: Dades Agricultural Company.

source: Below the sign, two glass windows suddenly opened, revealing a figure.
target: Sub tabula, duo fenestrae vitreae subito apertae sunt, figuram revelantes.

source: The figure, wearing a thin white shirt with the top two buttons undone despite the cold winter, had hair like it was stained with fresh blood, iron‑black eyes, and sharp facial features, exuding a fierce aura.
target: Figura, induta tenue alba tunica cum duobus nodis supremos solutis, nondum frigido hieme impediente, capillos quasi recenti sanguine tinctos, oculos ferreos nigrissimos, et lineamenta acuta habebat, aura ferocia effundens.

source: No introduction was needed; Lumian identified the figure from the sign and the resonating aura.
target: Nulla introductio necessaria fuit; Lumian figuram ex signo et aura resonante intellexit.

source: The most dangerous criminal in Morora, former experimental subject Wanak!
target: Criminalis periculosissimus in Morora, pristinus subiectus experimentalis, Wanak!

source: Did the resonance just now come from the direct corruption of 0‑01?
target: Num resonantia modo ex corruptione directa 0‑01 orta est?

source: Did the law of convergence lead to this encounter?
target: Num lex convergenceis hanc congressionem induxit?

source: Did Wanak escape the status of an experimental subject because he completely submitted to 0‑01?
target: Num Wanak effugere statum subiecti experimentalis potuit, quia penitus 0‑01 se subiecit?

source: Is he now 0‑01’s proxy in Morora?
target: Num nunc in Morora pro 0‑01 fungitur?

source: This Sealed Artifact, despite lacking wisdom, instinctively seeks opportunities to break free from its seal?
target: Hic Artificium Sigillatum, quamvis sapientia careat, instinctive occasiones quaerit ut sigillum suum rumpat?

source: As Lumian’s thoughts raced, the suspected Wanak suddenly transformed into a blazing‑white flame spear, filled with destructive energy, and flew at him.
target: Dum cogitationes Lumiani conflaebant, Wanak, qui suspectus erat, subito in hastam flammae candidae refulgens, energia destructiva plena, transformatus est et in eum volavit.

source: Lumian’s figure instantly disappeared without reappearing.
target: Figura Lumiani statim evanuit, sine se iterum ostendendo.

source: He directly teleported closer to the Abscessed Hand’s head.
target: Statim se translatus est propius ad caput Manus Abscissae.

source: In his ears echoed the taunting voice of the suspected Wanak, “Coward! Chicken!”
target: In auribus eius resonabat vox irridea: “Ignavus! Gallina!”

source: Lumian snorted, not turning back to fight the man.
target: Lumian sufflavit, neque se convertere ad virum pugnandum ausus est.

source: “I’ll first gather the Abscessed Hand’s body!”
target: “Primum corpus Manus Abscissae colligam!”

source: He feared the intense battle might lead to unforeseen events, making contact with 0‑01 before he collected all the body parts, resulting in uncontrollable consequences.
target: Timebat vehementem proelium ad eventus inattenditos ducere, quia 0‑01 contingere posset antequam omnia corpora congregeret, unde consequentiae incontrollabiles oriuntur.

source: Moreover, the aura and the flame spear the suspected Wanak displayed suggested he might have a trace of godhood.
target: Praeterea, aura et hasta flammae quam Wanak suspectus ostendit indicabant eum deitate aliquam vestigium habere.

source: Even if not truly Sequence 4, he had fundamentally differed from a Sequence 5 Beyonder.
target: Etiamsi non vere esset Series IV, radicitus ab Series V Beyonder se distinguebatur.

source: Demigods couldn’t approach 0‑01, but maybe pseudo‑demigod proxies created by 0‑01 weren’t subject to this rule!
target: Semidei ad 0‑01 appropinquare non poterant, sed fortasse pseudo‑semidei representantes, a 0‑01 creati, huic regulae non subiecti erant!

source: Lumian looked ahead, finding himself in the boundless cemetery behind the Church of Knowledge, surrounded by gravestones and trees.
target: Lumian ante se aspexit et se in coemeterio immensissimo post Ecclesiam Scientiae invenit, lapidibus sepulcralibus et arboribus circumdatum.

source: Uh… Lumian was momentarily stunned, then felt it made sense.
target: Heu… Lumian per momentum stupefactus est, deinde sensit se id intellegere posse.

source: The bar owner‑cum‑chef having half of the Abscessed Hand’s body and using it was an anomaly.
target: Tabernarius atque coquus, qui dimidium corporis Manus Abscissae haberet atque illud uti solebat, anomalia erat.

source: Normally, anyone, even a felon, encountering a rotting corpse split into multiple parts would first call the enforcers to clean up the scene.
target: Normaliter, quisquis—even sceleratus—qui cadaver putrescens in plura partes divisum incideret, primum exsecutores vocaret ut locum purgarent.

source: The enforcers would then bury the body in this cemetery as part of the seal.
target: Exsecutores deinde corpus in hoc coemeterio sepelirent ut pars sigillamenti.

source: Of course, this was a normal assumption, excluding those with a penchant for corpses.
target: Certe, hoc erat prorsus opinio communis, exceptis illis qui cadaveribus studiosi erant.

source: Lumian moved forward, approaching the source of the subtle connection.
target: Lumian procedebat, ad fontem subtilis nexus appropinquare conatus.

source: During this, he remembered something.
target: Interea aliquid meminit.

source: Madam Magician said dangerous things might happen once the Abscessed Hand’s body is gathered.
target: Magistra Magician dixit res periculosas evenire posse, cum corpus Manus Abscissae congregabitur.

source: It’s best to complete this step within the City of Exiles to offset the corresponding risks with the presence of 0‑01…
target: Optimum est hunc gradum intra Urbem Exulorum conficere, ut pericula correspondentia cum praesentia 0‑01 compensentur.

source: If I get the Hand Bro’s head later, does that count as gathering the body?
target: Si postea caput Hand Bro obtineam, idne censetur corpus congregare?

source: Will that cause dangerous events?
target: Num id res periculosas eveniet?

source: Maybe I should wait a bit longer?
target: Forsitan paulo diutius exspectare debeam?

source: Wait for dangerous and difficult‑to‑handle situations before teleporting back to gather Hand Bro’s body to create unknown risks and muddy the waters?
target: Exspecta res periculosas atque difficillimas ad tractandum, priusquam teletransportatione redeas ad corpus Hand Bro colligendum, ut pericula ignota creentur et res confundantur.

source: I can’t face the dangers of the Hand Bro alone; sharing is caring…
target: Non possum solus pericula Hand Bro tolerare; communitas enim auxilium praebet.

source: Also, Madam Magician implied that the Hand Bro might break the seal and enter Morora once its body is gathered?
target: Item, Magistra Magician insinuabat quod Hand Bro sigillum rumpere atque in Morora introiret, cum corpus eius congregaretur.

source: Otherwise, how could it be considered complete…
target: Aliter, quomodo id censeri completum posset…

source: Normally, not even a messenger can be summoned, nor a contract creature…
target: Normaliter, neque nuntius quidem evocari potest, nec creatura contracta.

source: This might help me escape Morora…
target: Hoc me forsitan adiuvabit ut Morora effugiam.

source: As Lumian pondered, he stopped at a recently filled pit without a tombstone.
target: Dum Lumian meditabat, subsistit ad puteum nuper impletum sine lapide sepulcrali.

source: His contract mark told him a part of the Abscessed Hand’s body was in this pit.
target: Notatio contractus eius indicavit ei partem corporis Manus Abscissae in hoc puteo esse.

source: Seeing the unusually fresh marks on the pit’s surface, Lumian felt a tightness in his chest.
target: Videns vestigia insolitè recens in superficie putei, Lumian angorem in pectore sensit.

source: He crouched down, extended his hands, and performed a directional blast.
target: Se inclinavit, manus extendit, et impetum directum inieci.

source: With the rumbling sound of explosions, he blew away a large amount of soil and unearthed a black wooden box from the bottom of the pit.
target: Cum rugitu explosionum, magnam terræ copiam evellit et arcam ligneam nigram ex fundo putei extraxit.

source: Opening the box, Lumian saw a highly decomposed, blue‑black, swollen ear and a folded white paper.
target: Arcam aperiens, Lumian vidit auriculam valde corruptam, caeruleo‑nigrum et tumidam, atque chartam album plicatam.

source: Lumian unfolded the paper, seeing words written in Intisian:
target: Lumian chartam explicavit, et verba in lingua Intisiana scripta vidit:

source: “As expected, you want this rotten head.
target: “Ut expectatum est, hoc caput putridum vis.

source: “But unfortunately, I got it before you went to the Carnivore bar and hid it.
target: “Sed, pro dolor, id accepi antequam ad bar Carnivorum accederes et occulteres.

source: “Maybe you can ask me for it.
target: “Forsitan id a me petere possis.

source: “Albus Medici.”
target: “Albus Medici.”
